scope: D3 conflicting evidence and new-cohort evaluation; focused primary-source reading, not a systematic review
method: Paraphrases checked against previously acquired primary JATS full texts and current primary web sources; full articles are not redistributed

studies.read_level_this_stage: Full text reviewed for relevant claims from previously acquired primary JATS XML, with current primary-source search verification
source_locators: Predictors: Demographic, Clinical Data, and MGMT Promoter Methylation Status

facts.population: Adults with IDH-wildtype glioblastoma and suspected progression within seven months after radiotherapy, subject to the study's other eligibility requirements
facts.reference_standard: Predominantly subsequent imaging evolution and clinical follow-up; repeat histology not routinely available
clinical_MGMT_inputs: time from radiotherapy completion to suspicious lesion
facts.radiomics_models_reported_direction: Lower AUCs than the clinical-MGMT reference

studies.permitted_claim: No statistically significant improvement after adding median ADC/nrCBV; lower AUCs for the reported radiomics combinations in this selected cohort
studies.limits: These findings do not prove that radiomics or higher complexity always harms performance. Baseline predictors, target endpoint, processing and sampling differ from ours; no causal attribution of performance differences is established. Avoid importing the article's percentage typo for 20 of 105 patients.

studies.read_level_this_stage: Full text reviewed for relevant claims from primary JATS XML and current open publisher full text
source_locators: Validation of multiparametric MRI based prediction model

facts.development_grouping: True progression versus pseudoprogression plus mixed tumor
facts.validation_grouping: Pseudoprogression versus progression plus mixed tumor
facts.model_origin: Previously developed diffusion-perfusion regression model applied to a new cohort; authors also report an additional leave-one-out analysis

studies.permitted_claim: New-cohort evaluation yielded AUC 0.757 and asymmetric class recognition, while the allocation of mixed tumors changed between development and evaluation
studies.limits: Use AUC 0.757 as specified in Figure 7, not 75.7% overall classification accuracy. Overall fixed-threshold correct classification was 39/56. Do not treat the changed task as a pure unchanged-endpoint test of transportability, or as validation of our model. Do not claim a lower AUC was caused solely by cohort transport or by label regrouping.

access_notes.observed: Current open publisher full text available
access_notes.action: Cross-checked model application, changed outcome grouping, exact correct/total counts and Figure 7 AUC against the primary JATS text

interpretations.claim: These studies show heterogeneous results and classification tasks, not a uniform direction of fusion benefit
The cited comparisons cannot isolate the causal effect of complexity or explain the differences in our results
interpretations.type: Design limitation; predictor sets, reference standards and samples vary

interpretations.claim: Our single-scan incremental uncertainty and minority-class recognition remain material despite a favorable primary AUC difference
Further evaluation should preserve the intended reference categories and test a locked model in an independent cohort
interpretations.type: Recommendation derived from observed task differences and lack of independent validation of our model
